correctness.rationale: The proof derives the elementary conjugation identities, shows that collapsing adjacent edges forces constant maps, extracts injective vertex maps from stars for n>=5, analyzes n=3 triangles, and shows that every nonconstant noninjective n=4 map factors uniquely through the opposite-edge T3 quotient. It verifies the 24 exceptional maps multiply as S3 times a four-element left-zero semigroup. A standalone exhaustive verifier independently computed 26 rank histograms and the 576 exceptional products. The finite checks only corroborate the general proof.

originality.rationale: The inspected 2024 primitivity theorem directly covers source simplicity and hence the injective-or-constant dichotomy; no novelty is claimed for that implication. The assessed exact contribution is all cross-size embedding classifications and counts, including the n=4 opposite-edge quotient and rank-three multiplication law. Full/targeted inspections of four relevant works and searches for equivalent statements found no dominating published result. Broader unlocated embedding work remains a risk.
residual_risks: A broad general theorem for embeddings of 3-transposition quandles or conjugation subquandles could implicitly imply the present classification even if its title does not match.
Primary search can miss unindexed theses, database tables or terminology such as Fischer spaces, Steiner triples or triangular graphs.
The known 2024 source-simplicity result already implies one weaker portion of the claim; that weaker portion is not represented as an original discovery.

value.rationale: The complete Hom-set profile across all ordered size pairs is a natural category-of-quandles invariant, including exact possible ranks, multiplicities and embedding obstructions. The isolated n4 opposite-edge quotient has a concrete S3 times left-zero semigroup structure and four exceptional idempotents. These are motivated natural classification and boundary data beyond a generic simplicity corollary, with independently reproducible finite illustrations.
